title: AI Technical Reference
readerIntent: Audit AI providers, economics, knowledge, assistants, tools, recovery, and verification.
owner: Nodics AI modules and every invoked capability owner
summary: Every AI feature declares authority, configuration, identity, data, model/provider, budgets, tools, approval, lifecycle, observability, failure, and release evidence.

sections.heading: Checklist
items: Usage profile, provider capabilities, model, reviewed pricing, secret reference, timeout, cancellation, fallback, rate, circuit, and kill switch.
Tenant, enterprise, project, user, conversation, operation budgets, reservation, ledger, reconciliation, and retention.
Corpus/source ownership, schema/service read contract, chunking, embedding, search mode, version, freshness, permission, evidence, and citation.
Assistant definition, approved prompt, context/redaction, conversation ownership, SSE events, leases, cancellation, recovery, tools, confirmation, and Workflow handoff.
Positive, negative, boundary, contract, integration, concurrency, prompt-injection, authorization, cost, load, outage, recovery, live-provider, security, and regression tests.
